title: Factory Complimentary Maintenance Schedule — Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage
content:
# Factory Complimentary Maintenance Schedule

Within the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage, each coverage type states, by vehicle make, the number of factory complimentary maintenance visits included and the mileage interval of those visits. An interval of 0 means a single visit with no interval.

## Visits included and interval by make

| Coverage type | Figure | Toyota | Honda | Ford | Chevrolet | Hyundai |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | visits included | 5 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 4 |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | interval (miles) | 5,000 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 7,500 |
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty, Factory Basic Limited Warranty, Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty, Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty, Federal Emissions Performance Warranty, Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | visits included | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| (same six coverage types) | interval (miles) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Reading the schedule by make

- **Toyota:** 5 visits, one at each 5,000-mile interval.
- **Hyundai:** 4 visits, one at each 7,500-mile interval.
- **Chevrolet:** 1 visit; the interval of 0 means it is a single visit with no interval.
- **Honda and Ford:** 0 visits included.
